messages:
carmen: opened a small docs PR to tighten streaming + pagination snippets across py/ts/go. Added a tiny 'resume token checkpoint' helper to avoid restarting from page 1 on transient errors. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/528

akshay: can you paste the TypeScript async iterator example? want to ensure it awaits correctly and preserves token between retries.

carmen: pasted minimal example in the PR but here it is inline:

carmen: ```ts
// compact TS example: resume-aware async iterator
import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference'
import { resumeWithCheckpoint } from '@redwood/docs-utils'

const client = new Redwood()
let checkpoint = null
for await (const page of resumeWithCheckpoint(async () => await client.streamPages({ page_token: checkpoint }))) {
  handlePage(page)
  checkpoint = page.next_token ?? null
}
```

rachel: looks good. please add one sentence calling out that checkpoint is in-memory by default and point to persistence example for Redis in the PR. also wrap the PR link to avoid MD034.

docs-bot: Lint: docs/snippets/stream-paginate.md: MD013/line-length at 28.

ci-bot: running CI on PR 528...

ci-bot: integration:examples:typescript: failed 	3: missing await in example causing lint error.

akshay: small nit: the call factory should be a function that returns the iterator; change to () => client.streamPages({ page_token: checkpoint }) and ensure the helper awaits it inside.

carmen: fixed snippet, pushed commit, wrapped PR link per rachel.

ci-bot: all checks passed. merging. release note: docs: streaming/pagination snippets - add resume checkpoint helper (PR #528)

carmen: thanks! i'll follow up with a short migration note for teams with custom resumers and include the Redis example.
